title: Experimental procedures for studying microbial reactions under high hydrogen gas saturations in microcosms
author: Jaques, Ireland, et al.

steps.title: Prepare microcosm bottles
steps.instruction: Use 250 mL borosilicate crimp‑seal Wheaton bottles; add 5.0 g of mixed sediment inoculum with a sterile syringe, then add 100 mL basal media via a strippette while bubbling nitrogen through the liquid to keep conditions anoxic.

steps.title: Seal and invert bottles
steps.instruction: Seal each bottle with a butyl rubber stopper and a 20 mm aluminium crimp seal; invert the bottle so the liquid contacts the stopper for the incubation period.

steps.title: Flush headspace with gases
steps.instruction: Flush the headspace with nitrogen for 5 min, then with a 50 % H₂ / 50 % N₂ mixture for 5 min at 3 psi using a 19 G (1.1 × 50 mm) injection needle and a 21 G (0.8 × 38 mm) vent needle (Terumo Agani); remove both needles simultaneously after 5 min.

steps.title: Incubate microcosms
steps.instruction: Place the sealed, inverted bottles in incubators set at 30 °C and 50 °C for the 18‑day experiment, removing them only for sampling.

steps.title: Collect gas samples for H₂ analysis
steps.instruction: Using a 2.5 mL gastight Hamilton 1002SL syringe with a 26S Hamilton needle, withdraw 1.5 mL of headspace gas from each exetainer for hydrogen measurement.

steps.title: Analyze H₂ by GC‑TCD
steps.instruction: Bake the SRI 8610C GC‑TCD at 300 °C for 2.5 h; inject each 1.5 mL sample via a 0.5 mL loop onto a 6‑ft packed 5 Å molecular‑sieve column at 30 psi nitrogen carrier, column temperature 40 °C, TCD temperature 100 °C; after every nine samples run a drift standard of 1.5 mL 1 % H₂ / 99 % N₂; manually integrate peak areas.

steps.title: Analyze CH₄, CO₂, H₂S by GC‑MS
steps.instruction: Run an Agilent 5977B GC‑MS with helium carrier at 49.5 mL min⁻¹ and 6.181 psi; set oven to 35 °C and detector heat to 150 °C; prepare standards of 1 % CH₄/CO₂ + 98 % N₂ and 10 % CH₄/CO₂ + 80 % N₂ at volumes of 20, 40, 60, 80, and 100 µL; manually inject 100 µL of each exetainer sample every 2 min.

steps.title: Record sampling data
steps.instruction: Sample headspace and record gas concentrations every other day, excluding weekends, throughout the experiment.
